In the education warehouse silver star schema, 'active students each school year' is COUNT(DISTINCT student_sk) from silver.fact_enrolment grouped by academic_year. Do not confuse total historical students in dim_student (~1.6k) with active students per academic_year. academic_year is derived on silver load as entry_calendar_year + (class.year_level - student.year_level); enrolment grain is (student_sk, class_sk, academic_year).
